questions.q: Choose the word opposite in meaning to “transparent”:
questions.why: Opaque lets no light through. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Identify the principal clause in: “When the bell rang, the students left the hall.”
opts: left the hall when the bell rang
questions.why: The principal clause makes complete sense on its own; 'When the bell rang' is subordinate. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct version: “He don’t like spicy food.”
questions.why: Third person singular present negative takes 'doesn’t' + base verb. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Identify the error: “One of my friends have gone abroad.”
questions.why: 'One of' takes a singular verb: 'has gone'. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct form: “Either the nurse or the doctor ____ on duty tonight.”
questions.why: With 'either...or' the verb agrees with the nearer subject (doctor, singular). GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the word closest in meaning to “rapid”:
questions.why: 'Rapid' means moving at great speed, as does 'swift'. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q:
Rearrange the sentences P, Q, R and S to form a meaningful paragraph:
P. Disappointed, he returned home and called his manager.
Q. Ravi woke up late that morning.
R. At the station, he learnt that the train had already left.
S. He dressed hurriedly and hailed a taxi.
questions.why: Chronological order: wakes, dresses, learns, returns. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: “We congratulated him ____ his success.”
Spot the error: “Neither the teacher nor the students was present.”
questions.why: With neither…nor the verb agrees with the nearer subject, 'students': 'were'. GPSC CBRT, Feb 2026.

questions.q: Choose the correct article: “____ sun rises in the east.”
questions.why: Unique objects take 'the'. GPSC-style practice item.
